purpose: Evaluate agent-built interactive Unreal artifacts without allowing static visual quality to hide behavioral defects.

required: frozen task specification and acceptance tests
Unreal Engine version and enabled plugins
comparability_envelope.classification: workflow comparison unless the complete envelope is identical

hard_gates.name: artifact_opens
hard_gates.acceptance: The retained UE 5.8 project opens without repair or version conversion.

hard_gates.name: builds_and_runs
hard_gates.acceptance: The target map builds and enters a playable or executable state without fatal errors.

hard_gates.name: core_interaction_replays
hard_gates.acceptance: A retained deterministic input sequence reaches the task's required observable outcome.

hard_gates.name: evidence_complete
hard_gates.acceptance: Prompt, manifest, logs, replay inputs, captures, elapsed time, and cost basis are retained.

reliability_rule.prohibited: Do not present a best run or one recorded attempt as reliability.

judge_policy.llm_judge: advisory unless rubric, inputs, model version, output, and scoring trace are retained
judge_policy.human_review: required for disputed visual preference claims

claim_boundary: This protocol is derived from inspected video evidence and prior Beast proof discipline. It has not yet been validated across repeated UE 5.8 builds.
